I run the #1 vibe coding agency. We've built 250+ apps for clients using AI.

Here's the exact tech stack behind every build:

1/ @Lovable

This is our main coding agent. It gets us off the ground faster than anything else. Great design out of the box. Backend and infrastructure setup from the jump. We go from idea to working prototype in hours, not weeks. Every client project starts here.

2/ Supabase

This is our backend of choice. Database, APIs, security, and auth all in one platform. The real advantage? It's baked directly into Lovable. No extra config. No messy integrations. You connect it once and everything just works. For us it was the obvious choice.

3/ Claude Cowork

Lovable handles basic testing on its own. But when you're shipping real products for real clients, you need more. PlayerZero lets us run advanced product cycle testing in one automated process. Fewer bugs. Faster QA. Clients never see a broken build.

4/ Stripe

Every app we build that takes money runs through Stripe. Subscriptions, one time payments, invoicing. It plugs into Supabase cleanly and Lovable can scaffold the full checkout flow in minutes. Payments used to be the hardest part of shipping. Now it's one of the fastest.

5/ Mixpanel

You can't improve what you don't measure. Mixpanel gives us event tracking, funnels, and retention data from day one. We wire it into every client app so they know exactly where users drop off and what's converting. Analytics isn't optional. It's how you prove the app works.

This stack lets a small team ship at the speed of a 50 person dev shop.

No bloated tools. No unnecessary complexity. Just five platforms that do the job.

That's how you build software in 2026.
